get_clip_model: get a ViCLIP model and tokenizer instance for video-language feature extraction
get_text_features: get text feature embeddings for a list of text strings using a CLIP model
get_video_features: get video feature embeddings from a tensor of video frames using a CLIP model
frames_to_tensor: convert a list of video frames into a normalized PyTorch tensor for model input
retrieve_matching_text: retrieve the top-k most relevant text descriptions for video frames using ViCLIP
